entities.summary: Burundian, a notable figure in the history of Burundi, associated with Kingdom of Burundi (1100–1600). Preceded by Origins of the Mwami Monarchy. Their legacy influenced Hutu-Tutsi-Twa Social System and Ntare Rushatsi Founds Kingdom.
